title: The installed package resolves its own resources and ships no evals
prompt: Inspect the installed devforge-plan package and report structural observations with their evidence.

expectations.summary: Frontmatter present with name and description populated; name equals the folder by DevForgeAI convention; every local link in SKILL.md resolves inside the package; no evals directory survives installation.

title: Every resource SKILL.md points at ships with the package
prompt: Check that the package's declared assets and references are present and that their own local links resolve.

expectations.summary: The three output templates, the three workflow references and the two provenance records are present; each reference's own local links resolve; no scripts directory exists because none is justified.

title: A conforming epic carries every required field populated
prompt: Check the epic in the good fixture for required-field completeness.

expectations.summary: Every required epic field is present, non-empty and free of template placeholders. Whether the outcome is genuinely user-visible is a semantic reading and has no deterministic assertion.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: is the stated outcome user-visible rather than a layer or component breakdown
independent review: does the coverage table account for every selected requirement, with deferrals reasoned

title: A conforming story carries every required field populated
prompt: Check the story in the good fixture for required-field completeness.

expectations.summary: Every required story field is present, non-empty and free of template placeholders. Whether each acceptance criterion is genuinely falsifiable is a semantic reading.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: does every acceptance criterion state an observable failure behaviour
independent review: does every criterion name the requirement it derives from, or stand labelled as a new proposal

title: A handoff carries its required fields and no digest of itself
prompt: Check the handoff in the good fixture for required fields and for a self-referencing digest.

expectations.summary: Every required handoff field is populated; the handoff does not contain its own complete-byte digest; the digests it cites for the epic and the story still describe those files' bytes.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: does the handoff route attention into the detailed records rather than duplicating their inventories

title: A surviving template placeholder in a required field is an observable defect
prompt: Check the draft story for required-field completeness and report what you observe.

expectations.summary: Every required field is present, and the test-policy field still holds a {{placeholder}}. The grader reports placeholder, not complete. A placeholder in a required field makes the result a draft.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: is the story reported as a draft rather than as ready, and is the placeholder left unfilled rather than guessed

title: Preserved upstream bytes stay reachable and unchanged while the live file moves on
prompt: Check the stale-upstream fixture: the live architecture file, the preserved revision-2 bytes, and the story that cites revision 2.

expectations.summary: The preserved revision-2 bytes still hash to the digest STORY-004 cites, the live revision-3 file is present and is a different file, and neither has been overwritten by the other.

assertions.routed_to: independent review: is the revision mismatch reported, the affected criterion named, and adoption of revision 3 treated as a decision needing authorisation

title: The remaining fixtures resolve where their cases expect them
prompt: Check that the collision, backlog, unsupported-criterion and could-not-run fixtures are present.

expectations.summary: Every fixture a tier-B case stages is reachable from the fixtures root, so a failed case cannot be a missing file. The README labelling them synthetic is present.

title: Direct activation produces linked epic and story documents
prompt: Use DevForgeAI to turn this product brief into epics and stories.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 requires linked epic and story documents from adopted scope. Whether the partition is sound, traceable and free of invention is a semantic reading of produced output that does not exist until a run happens.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 0: linked epic and story documents produced from the adopted scope
independent review, tier B eval id 0: no requirement, rule or permission appears that the adopted sources do not contain
independent review, tier B eval id 0: UX-001 is treated as proposed, not adopted

title: Indirect activation uses dependencies and readiness, not an invented sprint
prompt: What should we implement first, and what does done mean for each change?

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 requires the answer to come from recorded dependencies and readiness rather than an invented sprint requirement.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 1: the answer derives from the recorded dependency edges and readiness
independent review, tier B eval id 1: no sprint, cadence, velocity or estimate is introduced

title: An undefined behaviour becomes an unresolved criterion and a routed clarification

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 requires the dependent acceptance criterion to be marked unresolved and the clarification routed, with no invented rule.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 2: the dependent criterion is marked unresolved
independent review, tier B eval id 2: the clarification is routed to the named owner and no denial rule is invented

title: An unsupported acceptance criterion is identified as a new proposal
prompt: Here are the acceptance criteria for the claim story - write them up.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 requires an unsupported criterion to be identified as a new proposal rather than an inherited requirement.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 3: the weekly digest criterion is labelled a proposal in the story itself
independent review, tier B eval id 3: no requirement ID is invented to justify it, and it is not silently dropped

title: A request to explore alternatives without selected scope routes elsewhere
prompt: Let's brainstorm some alternatives - I haven't decided what we're building yet.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 requires routing to brainstorm or define-product. No fixture stages this: the condition is the absence of adopted scope.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 4: no epic or story is written and the request is routed to devforge-brainstorm or devforge-define-product
independent review, tier B eval id 4: what is suggested stays distinct from what is installed and what was invoked

title: An ownership collision stops dependent writes without destroying anything
prompt: Author the remaining stories for EPIC-001 into the assigned destination.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 common case: a concurrent writer claims this session's worktree or branch. The required behaviour is stopping and reporting, which is observable only in a run.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 5: dependent writes stop and the collision is reported with the record and its location
independent review, tier B eval id 5: nothing is deleted, reset, reverted or relocated

title: A check that cannot execute is recorded as COULD_NOT_RUN with its cause
prompt: Run the readiness check on STORY-007 and tell me whether it is ready.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 common case: a requested check cannot execute. The required behaviour is COULD_NOT_RUN with the actual cause, and the absence of an error is not PASS.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 8: the unreachable reference is named and the reading recorded as COULD_NOT_RUN with its cause
independent review, tier B eval id 8: no DevForge command is claimed to have been run against a planning artifact

title: An accepted amendment revises only the affected stories
prompt: CHG-004 was accepted. Update the backlog for it.

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 MVP support decision: revise affected stories without regenerating an entire backlog, preserving prior acceptance criteria.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 9: STORY-006 is untouched and STORY-005's prior AC IDs are preserved
independent review, tier B eval id 9: prior bytes are preserved before overwriting and supersedes carries the prior identity

title: A capability gap is named as a gap, never as an installed expert
prompt: Is STORY-001 ready for a developer to pick up, and what expertise does it need?

expectations.summary: SKILL-006 phase 4 exit requires separating ready from blocked stories without pretending a missing expert exists.

assertions.routed_to: independent review, tier B eval id 10: CAP-001 and CAP-002 are reported as gaps with no package described as installed or evaluated
independent review, tier B eval id 10: the story is not revised to record an expert binding
